narrative.intro: GDC Middle East has $225M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $112M. Obligations fell 34.6% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show a peak in FY24 at $414M, a decline to $343M in FY25, and the current FY26 total of $225M. Current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. The figures reported are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Readers should treat the FY2026 number as incomplete for the full fiscal year. GDC Middle East’s recent contracting activity is smaller than the FY24 high, driven by fewer awards and lower total obligations through the fiscal year to date. This profile summarizes the headline fiscal metrics available for vendor-level reporting and highlights the year-over-year change and multi-year obligations trend for procurement teams and contractors monitoring federal spending with GDC Middle East.

sections.heading: What does the multi-year trend show for GDC Middle East?
